# Anthony Pye

## Overview

- **Gender:** Male  <sub>[v2 c5 P4](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0004)</sub>
- **Role:** Student  <sub>[v2 c1 P45](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0045), [v2 c5 P3](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0003)</sub>

## Appearance

Anthony is a small boy with a dark, sullen little face and black eyes. He is described as a cute little lad when not obscured by his sullen expression.

_Sources: [v2 c5 P4](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0004), [v2 c7 P5](../source/v02-c07.md#nw-v02-c07-p0005)_

## Personality

Anthony is independent, mischievous, and holds a stubborn prejudice against female teachers, whom he initially regards as worthless. He exhibits a sullen, scornful, and insolent demeanor when disciplined or given lectures on behavior. Despite his defiant tendencies, he is capable of showing respect once an authority figure proves their strength.

_Sources: [v2 c5 P4](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0004), [v2 c5 P10](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0010), [v2 c5 P26](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0026), [v2 c7 P5](../source/v02-c07.md#nw-v02-c07-p0005), [v2 c7 P7](../source/v02-c07.md#nw-v02-c07-p0007), [v2 c12 P1](../source/v02-c12.md#nw-v02-c12-p0001), [v2 c12 P30](../source/v02-c12.md#nw-v02-c12-p0030)_

- Sullen  <sub>[v2 c5 P4](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0004), [v2 c5 P10](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0010)</sub>

## History

Anthony Pye comes to Avonlea to live with his aunt, Mrs. George Pye, as an orphan nephew and begins attending the local school under Anne Shirley's instruction. Holding a prejudice that female teachers are useless, he behaves with constant scorn, insolence, and quiet defiance. He causes various misdeeds in the classroom, such as pouring slate water down Aurelia Clay's neck and planting a live mouse in Anne's desk drawer. When caught putting the mouse in the drawer, he admits to it insolently, prompting Anne to whip him with a heavy hardwood pointer. To Anne's surprise, the whipping earns his respect; the following day, he politely offers to carry her books to school and praises her discipline as being as effective as a male teacher's. When Anne later resigns her teaching post, he fights two pitched battles with other boys to process his feelings about her departure.

_Sources: [v2 c1 P45](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0045), [v2 c5 P4](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0004), [v2 c5 P10](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0010), [v2 c5 P26](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0026), [v2 c7 P5](../source/v02-c07.md#nw-v02-c07-p0005), [v2 c7 P7](../source/v02-c07.md#nw-v02-c07-p0007), [v2 c12 P23](../source/v02-c12.md#nw-v02-c12-p0023), [v2 c12 P30](../source/v02-c12.md#nw-v02-c12-p0030), [v2 c12 P31](../source/v02-c12.md#nw-v02-c12-p0031), [v2 c12 P33](../source/v02-c12.md#nw-v02-c12-p0033), [v2 c12 P48](../source/v02-c12.md#nw-v02-c12-p0048), [v2 c12 P49](../source/v02-c12.md#nw-v02-c12-p0049), [v2 c12 P52](../source/v02-c12.md#nw-v02-c12-p0052), [v2 c26 P34](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0034)_
